caption: The dialog Install app for Compass with the access it asks for: View customer data (Sensitive data, device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, orders, store analytics), with the buttons Cancel and Install; the store name, the organization name and the avatars in the left menu are hidden.

The first screen of the app, Welcome to Compass, with the text about a 14-day trial that only starts after you subscribe, Connect Meta and blended ROAS, and the single button Choose your plan; the store name in the bottom left corner is hidden.

The page Choose your plan with Compass Monthly at $49 / month and Compass Annual at $490 / year ($41/month billed annually, Save 17% vs monthly), the same six features on both cards and a Start free trial button on each; the store name is hidden.

The Shopify screen Approve subscription for Compass Monthly with a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a subtotal and total of $49,00 due 1 Dec, $49,00 USD every 30 days, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button; the store name is hidden.
